55032-poems-of-progress.title: Progress.
55032-poems-of-progress.creator: Lizzie Doten.
55032-poems-of-progress.description: A book by Lizzie Doten.. Doubtless many who take up this book, and glance carelessly at its pages, will exclaim, “What! more Spiritualism!” To which remark I answer, yes, more Spiritualism, an unequivocal, undisguised, positive Spiritualism--confirmed by many years of careful observation, study, and experience, and of which this book is the legitimate outgrowth.

arxiv-2211-03782.title: On minimal variations for unsupervised representation learning
arxiv-2211-03782.creator: Vivien Cabannes, Alberto Bietti, Randall Balestriero
arxiv-2211-03782.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vivien Cabannes, Alberto Bietti, Randall Balestriero. Unsupervised representation learning aims at describing raw data efficiently to solve various downstream tasks. It has been approached with many techniques, such as manifold learning, diffusion maps, or more recently self-supervised learning. Those techniques are arguably all based on the underlying assumption that target functions, associated with future downstream tasks, have low variations in densely populated regions of the input space.

arxiv-2303-14975.description: Abstract We describe all possible topological structures of typical one-parameter bifurcations of gradient flows on the 2-sphere with holes in the case that the number of singular point of flows is at most six. To describe structures, we separatrix diagrams of flows.

arxiv-2410-10965.title: Co-precession of a curved jet and compact accretion disk in M87
arxiv-2410-10965.creator: Yuzhu Cui, Weikang Lin
arxiv-2410-10965.description: Abstract Observational constraints on the configuration of the black hole (BH)-accretion disk-jet system are crucial to understanding BH spin, accretion disk physics, and jet formation. The recently reported variation in the M87 jet position angle (PA) provides a novel avenue to explore these long-standing issues.

arxiv-2412-18008.description: Abstract . Contraction Hierarchies (CH) (Geisberger et al., 2008) is one of the most widely used algorithms for shortest-path queries on road networks. Compared to Dijkstra’s algorithm, CH enables orders of magnitude faster query performance through a preprocessing phase, which iteratively categorizes vertices into hierarchies and adds shortcuts. However, constructing a CH is an expensive task.

arxiv-2511-13285.creator: Yunjie Yu, Jingchen Wu, Junchen Zhu, Chunze Lin, Guibin Chen
arxiv-2511-13285.description: Abstract Artistic design such as poster design often demands rapid yet precise modification of textual content while preserving visual harmony and typographic intent, especially across diverse font styles. pmc-13317525.description: BACKGROUNDVagal-glossopharyngeal neuralgia (VGPN) represents a rare and often misdiagnosed condition.
